observations: The console features a three-tier design, identifying it as a PlayStation 4 Pro.
Front right of the console displays the 'PS4' logo.
The top surface features a Star Wars Galactic Empire emblem and 'STAR WARS' branding on the front edge.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers are placed on top of the console.
Included cables are a UK-plug power lead and an HDMI cable.
A watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICAL' is visible across the image.
The console casing shows some dust and light surface marks.

identity.model: PlayStation 4 Pro Star Wars Battlefront II Edition

claims.evidence: The three-tier chassis and 'PS4' logo in photo 0 are specific to the Pro model.
Photo 0 shows dust and minor surface marks on the console's top plate.
The warranty seals on the back of the console are not shown.
Authenticity of the controllers cannot be confirmed without seeing the rear labels.
The seller mentions a receipt but it is not included in the photos.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the tamper-evident warranty stickers on the rear of the console.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of the stickers on the underside of both controllers.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console to check warranty seals and port condition.
Video of the console running a game and connecting to the internet.

response.reason: The console is clearly a PS4 Pro Star Wars edition. While functional claims and internal condition are unverified, it can be priced at the worst-case value using the available PS4 Pro comparable.
